title: DCP 2/2025 (Amendment No. 4): rental or leasing effective 6% from 1 January 2026
summary: From 1 January 2026 RMCD grants a 2% exemption on the service-tax rate for rental or leasing, producing a 6% effective charge while the statutory rate remains 8%, until the legislation is amended. The path stays semantically standard.

legal_basis.title: Dasar Cukai Perkhidmatan Bil. 2/2025 (Pindaan No. 4) — Sewaan atau Pajakan
legal_basis.instrument: RMCD Service Tax Policy No. 2/2025 (Amendment No. 4), item 8
legal_basis.pinpoint: Bil. 8: pengecualian 2% atas kadar cukai perkhidmatan sewaan atau pajakan, berkuat kuasa 1 Januari 2026; Lampiran B

legal_basis.title: MySST | Background
legal_basis.instrument: RMCD MySST webpage, Tax Rate section

changes.summary: Rental or leasing service tax remains 8% as a statutory rate and is reduced administratively to a 6% effective charge.

migration_impact.summary: Invoicing for rental or leasing from 1 January 2026 should charge 6% while recording that the statutory rate is still 8%. Do not move these services onto the First Schedule 6% treatment.

computation.base_formula: 8% statutory reduced administratively to 6% effective by Service Tax Policy / RMCD DCP 2/2025

before.description: General 8% statutory and effective rate on rental or leasing.
